title: Fossil fuels still absent in latest COP31 draft deal
story: A new draft agreement at the COP31 climate

in Turkey still does not mention fossil fuels. Instead, its opening line recalls "the United Arab Emirates Consensus in its entirety" - a reference to the agreement reached in Dubai three years ago, when countries agreed to transition away from fossil fuels in their
systems. Whether those words are enough for Ireland, its EU partners and the countries that pressed for a stronger commitment is the question facing the summit this
. The closing plenary is due to resume at 9am in Antalya (6am Irish time). The talks are now in their second day of overtime and could still end without
on the main text. Yesterday evening, Minister for Climate Darragh O'Brien and European Climate Commissioner Wopke Hoekstra joined ministers and negotiators from the UK, small
states and developing countries who walked together to the COP presidency's offices.
